articles.title: Delaware, New Jersey advance bills banning crypto ATMs
articles.snippet: Lawmakers in Delaware and New Jersey have advanced laws that would completely ban crypto ATMs, a measure that has only been enacted in three US states.

articles.title: Mastercard Enables AI Agent Payments With Help From Crypto Giants Like Coinbase, Ripple
articles.snippet: Mastercard's Agent Pay for Machines is designed to let AI buy services and settle transactions using cards, bank accounts, and stablecoins.

articles.title: Solana Sponsors the World Series of Poker, Enabling Crypto Entry Fees and Payouts
articles.snippet: Players can now enter World Series of Poker tournaments with SOL or stablecoins, with Solana branding to be prominent at events.
